home-desk.alt: The nurses' desk at night. You sit under a lamp reading a message on a screen; Bea leans on the desk with a mug of tea; Wick, the little clockwork owl, sits on the corner of the desk in the lamplight.

ch05-opener.alt: Under the desk lamp, you fit a row of small brass knobs across Wick's chest with a jeweller's screwdriver while Bea looks on, mug in hand.

ch05-training.alt: Wick sits alone on the desk while the knobs on its chest turn by themselves, a long strip of paper tape pouring out.
